audit.editing_archetype: Fast Multi-Clip Montage / Countdown Countdown Ranking
audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical crop gameplay with persistent top-left numbered ranking overlay (1 to 4) tracking clips in reverse order.
audit.subtitle_craft: Bouncing, centered, bold white and yellow karaoke-style captions with word-by-word chunking, scaling up on high-energy screams and comedic gasps.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Subtle context-aware push-ins on monster jump scares and character panic reactions to emphasize comedic timing without losing spatial clarity.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Heavy comedic SFX placement on screams, quick audio ducking, and raw horror game ambient sounds contrasting with sudden comedic panic.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Fast cuts jumping between escalating funny moments in reverse ranked order, building anticipation to the final top pick.
standout_techniques: Reverse countdown ranking list overlay to structure disparate gameplay clips into a cohesive narrative
Dynamic word-by-word subtitle scaling on high-pitch screams
Rapid transition jumps between funny jump-scare setups and punchlines
Clean removal of dead air between comedic beats
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Over-cluttering the screen with too many overlapping UI elements
Abrupt audio clipping during transition cuts
